words.word: be supposed to do / be sth.
words.explanation: 1 used to say what is expected or intended to happen, esp. when this has failed to happen 本应；本该
words.example: She was supposed to perform at the club on Friday.
words.phonetic: be supposed to do  be sth..mp3

words.explanation: used when you want to say, in just a few words, what is the most important point about a situation 总而言之；简单地说
words.example: In short, our situation is getting better.

words.explanation: to help make sth. happen 对某事起促成作用

words.explanation: ( spoken ) used when you think sb. may understand your remarks in the wrong way, or be offended by them 别误会

words.explanation: to think of an idea, plan, reply, etc. 想出，提出（主意、计划、回答等）

words.explanation: to be excited and pleased about sth. that is going to happen（喜滋滋地）期待，盼望

words.explanation: to start to love sb. 爱上
